_comment: Citations for every LeaderAbility entry in code/leaders.py _REGISTRY. Many of our LeaderAbility.name fields are flavour labels that do NOT match the codex — where they differ, rule_name reflects the actual 10e datasheet ability and effect tags '(approximation)' where the simulator's always-on flag is a loose translation of the real rule. Sources: Wahapedia 10e datasheets (https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/).

LeaderAbility.Bloodmaster's Locus.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
LeaderAbility.Bloodmaster's Locus.trigger: Bloodmaster is leading a friendly Bloodletters unit; the led unit makes an attack
LeaderAbility.Bloodmaster's Locus.effect: +1 to the Wound roll for the led Bloodletters squad — direct match to plus_one_to_wound=True. host_keys gated to chaos_daemons_library_bloodletters per the codex Leader entry (BSData v10.6.0, Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz, Bloodmaster profile: 'This model can be attached to the following unit: BLOODLETTERS').

LeaderAbility.Poxbringer's Locus.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
LeaderAbility.Poxbringer's Locus.trigger: Poxbringer is leading a friendly Plaguebearers unit; the led unit makes an attack
LeaderAbility.Poxbringer's Locus.effect: (approximation) +1 to the Wound roll for the led Plaguebearers squad. The codex grants 5+ critical hits — SwegHammer has no per-leader-aura flag for expanding the critical-hit threshold (crit thresholds are a weapon-profile property, not a leader-grantable aura in current plumbing). Plaguebearers' melee profile already carries [LETHAL HITS] on a 6, so the codex rule doubles the lethals-trigger rate from 1/6 -> 2/6. plus_one_to_wound is the closest direction-correct proxy (more attacks resolve into wounds). Feculent Despair's -1 enemy battle-shock test is skipped (no per-leader battle-shock aura plumbing). host_keys gated to chaos_daemons_library_plaguebearers (BSData Poxbringer Leader profile: 'PLAGUEBEARERS').

LeaderAbility.Changecaster's Locus.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
LeaderAbility.Changecaster's Locus.trigger: Changecaster is leading a friendly Pink Horrors or Blue Horrors unit (both are legal Leader attachments per BSData v10.6.0: 'PINK HORRORS, BLUE HORRORS'); the led unit makes a ranged attack
LeaderAbility.Changecaster's Locus.effect: (approximation) reroll Hit rolls of 1 in aura range. The codex grants [SUSTAINED HITS 1] on the led unit's ranged weapons (+1/6 hits on a natural 6). SwegHammer's LeaderAbility has no `sustained_hits_ranged` flag (schema gap — flagged for follow-up as `sustained_hits_ranged: int` on LeaderAbility), so this uses the same reroll_hit_ones proxy as TSON Infernal Master's [SUSTAINED HITS 1] grant: reroll-1s yields +1/6 hits, same numerical uplift as sustained-1-on-6, just via a different mechanism. DAEMONS-LOCUS-V1 fix: host_keys now correctly includes both chaos_daemons_library_pink_horrors AND chaos_daemons_library_blue_horrors. Both are confirmed separate UNIT_CATALOG keys (verified via UNIT_CATALOG inspection, wave-49). A prior comment incorrectly claimed Blue Horrors did not surface as a separate catalogue key — that comment was wrong and has been removed.

LeaderAbility.Swallow Energy.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.
LeaderAbility.Swallow Energy.trigger: Contorted Epitome is leading a friendly Daemonettes unit; the led unit takes a wound from a mortal wound or PSYCHIC attack
LeaderAbility.Swallow Energy.effect: (approximation, strictly stronger than codex) FNP 4+ applied army-wide-in-aura while leading Daemonettes. The codex restricts the FNP to mortal wounds and PSYCHIC attacks; SwegHammer does not tag attacks as PSYCHIC and does not distinguish mortal-wound sources from regular wounds inside the FNP roll, so the proxy applies FNP 4+ to all incoming damage on the led unit. Same pattern as the Librarian's Mental Fortress entry. Horrible Fascination is a once-per-opponent-Shooting-phase ritual with no equivalent aura plumbing; skipped. host_keys gated to chaos_daemons_library_daemonettes (BSData Contorted Epitome Leader profile: 'DAEMONETTES').

LeaderAbility.Keep Counting!.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
LeaderAbility.Keep Counting!.trigger: Spoilpox Scrivener is leading a friendly Plaguebearers unit; the led unit makes a melee attack
LeaderAbility.Keep Counting!.effect: Led Plaguebearers' melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (each unmodified Hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit). Modelled as sustained_hits_melee=1 with host_keys gated to chaos_daemons_library_plaguebearers per the BSData v10.6.0 Spoilpox Scrivener Leader profile (attaches to PLAGUEBEARERS). The sustained_hits_melee schema field was added in wave-50 commit 25af977 specifically so this leader could be added without a follow-up dataclass change. Second BSData ability 'Meet Your Quota!' (+1 Objective Control to the led unit) is not modelled — no oc_bonus_led_unit field exists on LeaderAbility yet.

LeaderAbility.Tormentbringer (Aura).quoted_text: While a friendly Slaanesh Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of this model, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
LeaderAbility.Tormentbringer (Aura).trigger: Tormentbringer is on the battlefield; a friendly SLAANESH Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" and makes a melee attack
LeaderAbility.Tormentbringer (Aura).effect: Affected Slaanesh Daemons units' melee weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Modelled as sustained_hits_melee=1 with host_keys gated to the SLAANESH Legiones Daemonica catalogue keys (_SLAANESH_DAEMON_HOSTS) rather than empty host_keys, so the aura does not broadcast to non-Slaanesh allies under Daemons of Chaos detachment composition. This is an army-aura within the Slaanesh sub-faction, not a Leader/Bodyguard buff. Tormentbringer's other ability 'Hysterical Frenzy' (a destroyed model in the unit fights after dying) is not modelled — no fight-phase-trigger flag exists.

LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Khorne.quoted_text: While a friendly KHORNE Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Khorne.trigger: Bloodthirster is on the battlefield; a friendly KHORNE Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of the Bloodthirster and makes a melee attack
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Khorne.effect: +1 to the melee Hit roll for the affected unit. Modelled as plus_one_to_hit_melee_only=True with host_keys gated to the catalogue keys carrying the KHORNE Legiones Daemonica keyword (Bloodletters, Bloodcrushers, Flesh Hounds, Skull Cannon, Khorne Soul Grinder, Skullmaster, Skulltaker, Karanak, Bloodmaster, Rendmaster on Blood Throne) per BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz. DAEMONS-DIAG-8: narrowed from prior plus_one_to_hit=True (all attack modes) to plus_one_to_hit_melee_only=True (melee only), matching the verbatim codex text which states 'each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack'. The prior broader flag incorrectly boosted the ranged profiles on Skull Cannon (Burning Skulls) and Khorne Soul Grinder (Phlegm Bombardment). The melee-only gate is enforced in code/units.py's attack resolution loop (mode == 'melee' check, same pattern as ORKS-DIAG-3's Warboss 'Might is Right' narrowing).

LeaderAbility.Rage Embodied.quoted_text: While a friendly KHORNE Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.
LeaderAbility.Rage Embodied.trigger: Skarbrand is on the battlefield; a friendly KHORNE Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of Skarbrand
LeaderAbility.Rage Embodied.effect: +1 Attacks on every melee weapon in the affected unit. Modelled as plus_one_attack=1 with host_keys gated to the KHORNE Legiones Daemonica catalogue keys (same roster as Bloodthirster's Daemon Lord of Khorne). (loose-edge) plus_one_attack in SwegHammer applies the +1 to every weapon profile carried by the attacker, which over-includes the ranged profiles on Skull Cannon / Khorne Soul Grinder. Direction-correct uplift, strictly weaker than fabricating the missing field; the codex rule explicitly only adds the attack to melee profiles.

LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Tzeentch.quoted_text: While a friendly TZEENTCH LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Tzeentch.trigger: Lord of Change is on the battlefield; a friendly TZEENTCH Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of the Lord of Change and makes a ranged attack
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Tzeentch.effect: +1 Strength on every ranged attack from the affected unit. Modelled as plus_one_strength_ranged=True with host_keys gated to the TZEENTCH Legiones Daemonica catalogue keys (Pink Horrors, Blue Horrors, Flamers, Screamers, Burning Chariot, Tzeentch Soul Grinder, Kairos Fateweaver, Changecaster, Fluxmaster, Fateskimmer, Exalted Flamer, The Blue Scribes, The Changeling) per BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz. The Shooting-phase 'select [IGNORES COVER] / [LETHAL HITS] / [SUSTAINED HITS D3] for the Bolt of Change' bullet on the same datasheet ability is a self-buff on the Lord of Change's own ranged weapon and is NOT modelled here — it would need a per-Lord-of-Change weapon-keyword toggle the simulator does not yet expose. The +1 Strength aura is the main mechanical contribution, and is faithful to the codex.

LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Nurgle.quoted_text: While a friendly Nurgle Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit.
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Nurgle.trigger: Great Unclean One is on the battlefield; a friendly NURGLE Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of the GUO and is the target of an attack
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Nurgle.effect: +1 Toughness on models in the affected NURGLE Daemons unit. Modelled as plus_one_toughness=True with host_keys gated to the NURGLE Legiones Daemonica catalogue keys (Plaguebearers, Nurglings, Plague Drones, Beasts of Nurgle, Nurgle Soul Grinder, Rotigus, Horticulous Slimux, Epidemius, Poxbringer, Sloppity Bilepiper, Spoilpox Scrivener) per BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz. Buff applied DEFENDER-side: read from tgt_buffs in code/units.py's wound-roll computation (+1 to target's effective_toughness). The Movement-phase 'select an enemy unit within 12" and subtract 1 from its Toughness until next Movement phase' bullet on the same datasheet ability is a target-debuff and is NOT modelled here — the simulator has no per-unit transient toughness debuff slot. The +1 T defensive aura is the main mechanical contribution and is faithful to the codex.

LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Slaanesh.quoted_text: While a friendly Slaanesh Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of this model, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1.
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Slaanesh.trigger: Keeper of Secrets is on the battlefield; a friendly SLAANESH Legiones Daemonica unit is within 6" of the KoS and makes a melee attack
LeaderAbility.Daemon Lord of Slaanesh.effect: AP improved by 1 (more negative) on every melee weapon in the affected unit. Modelled as plus_one_ap_melee=True with host_keys gated to the SLAANESH Legiones Daemonica catalogue keys (Daemonettes, Seekers, Fiends, Hellflayers, Slaanesh Soul Grinder, Shalaxi Helbane, Syll'esske, Contorted Epitome, Infernal Enrapturess, The Masque of Slaanesh, Tormentbringer, Tranceweaver) per BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz. The defensive -1-to-Hit-rolls-targeting-this-model bullet on the KoS datasheet (a per-Keeper self-buff) is NOT modelled here — it would need a per-defender hit-modifier slot that the simulator does not currently expose for individual models. The +1 melee AP aura is the main mechanical contribution and is faithful to the codex.

LeaderAbility.Prince of Darkness.quoted_text: While a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have the Stealth ability.
LeaderAbility.Prince of Darkness.trigger: Daemon Prince of Chaos is on the battlefield; a friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit is within 6" of the Daemon Prince and is the target of a ranged attack
LeaderAbility.Prince of Darkness.effect: -1 to the Hit roll on ranged attacks targeting the affected LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit. Modelled as grants_stealth_aura=True on the LeaderAbility; the -1 modifier is applied DEFENDER-side in code/units.py (tgt_buffs["grants_stealth_aura"]) at the same location as the static target.profile.stealth check (mode != "melee" gate). Subject to the 10e ±1 modifier cap — stacks with heavy cover's -1 but the cap collapses the net to -1 either way. host_keys = _LEGIONES_DAEMONICA_HOSTS (union of all four god-aligned rosters plus UNDIVIDED units: Be'lakor, Daemon Prince of Chaos, Daemon Prince of Chaos with Wings). Daemon Prince is a MONSTER with no formal Leader/Bodyguard attachment; the 10e aura wording is "friendly LEGIONES DAEMONICA unit is within 6"" — broadcast to all eligible units in proximity, not restricted to a led bodyguard squad. Faithful direct match to the codex text — no approximation required. BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz confirms the wording verbatim.

LeaderAbility.Lord of Decapitations.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
LeaderAbility.Lord of Decapitations.trigger: Skulltaker is leading a friendly Bloodletters unit (host_keys: chaos_daemons_library_bloodletters); the led unit makes a melee attack (mode == "melee") and scores a Critical Wound (unmodified wound roll of 6)
LeaderAbility.Lord of Decapitations.effect: Critical Wounds on melee attacks by the led Bloodletters bypass armour and invulnerable saves, dealing damage directly (same as the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] weapon keyword). Modelled as grants_devastating_wounds_melee=True on the LeaderAbility; the mode=="melee" gate is enforced in the attack-resolution loop in code/units.py. Faithful direct match to the codex text — no approximation. BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Chaos Daemons Library.cat.gz confirms the wording verbatim.

LeaderAbility.Rites of Battle.quoted_text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
LeaderAbility.Rites of Battle.trigger: Space Marines Captain is alive and a friendly unit is targeted with a Stratagem (once per battle round)
LeaderAbility.Rites of Battle.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. iter21 fabrication audit dropped the prior `reroll_hit_ones=True` offensive proxy — the real Rites of Battle is a Stratagem CP discount, not a damage-side aura. SwegHammer does not currently model per-Stratagem-spend CP discounts (only the Warlord-trait `cp_discount_per_round` army-wide drip and the once-per-battle `cp_refund_per_battle` pool). The LeaderAbility entry remains in the registry so `host_keys` still resolves Captain as a valid Marines leader for proximity / `is_actually_led` gates, but contributes no buff flags. Strictly weaker than the prior fabrication (no damage uplift on Captain-led units).

LeaderAbility.Spiritual Leader.quoted_text: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of this model. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
LeaderAbility.Spiritual Leader.trigger: Chaplain is alive and a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 12" is Battle-shocked (once per battle)
LeaderAbility.Spiritual Leader.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. iter21 fabrication audit dropped the prior `reroll_wound_ones=True` offensive proxy — the real Spiritual Leader is a once-per-battle Battle-shock removal on a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit, NOT a damage-side aura. The simulator does model Battle-shock (Battle._run_battleshock_phase), but the once-per-battle target-restricted nature of this ability is not currently wired as an auto-applicable leader effect. The LeaderAbility entry remains in the registry so `host_keys` still resolves Chaplain as a valid Marines leader for proximity / `is_actually_led` gates, but contributes no buff flags. Strictly weaker than the prior fabrication (no damage uplift on Chaplain-led units).

LeaderAbility.Narthecium.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, you can return 1 destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.
LeaderAbility.Narthecium.trigger: Apothecary in aura range of destroyed friendly INFANTRY at each round end (simulator round-end revival step)
LeaderAbility.Narthecium.effect: revive 1 destroyed friendly INFANTRY model (non-CHARACTER) per round at full HP, preferring models from a profile whose live peers are inside the 3" aura. Faithful match to the codex's return-a-model effect — SwegHammer models multi-model squads as N single-model Units, so the codex's 'return 1 destroyed model to the led unit' lands as 'reset a dead Unit's current_health to max'. Triggered at round end rather than Command phase because the simulator has no separate Command sub-phase.

LeaderAbility.Mental Fortress.quoted_text: Psychic Hood: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks. Mental Fortress (Psychic): While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
LeaderAbility.Mental Fortress.trigger: defender's unit is led by a Librarian in aura range
LeaderAbility.Mental Fortress.effect: FNP 5+ in aura range (defensive proxy; the real Librarian rules grant FNP 4+ against PSYCHIC attacks plus a 4+ invuln from Mental Fortress. SwegHammer does not tag attacks as psychic or distinguish invuln-vs-armour for an aura-granted save, so we proxy the defensive bundle as army-wide FNP 5+ — a strictly weaker, direction-correct stand-in. Both halves of the codex effect are defensive, matching the FNP direction.)

LeaderAbility.My Will Be Done.quoted_text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
LeaderAbility.My Will Be Done.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. wave 235 removed the prior plus_one_to_hit=True fabricated proxy. The real My Will Be Done is a once-per-battle-round Stratagem command point discount — identical in pattern to Space Marine Captain Rites of Battle (iter21 drop) and Aeldari Autarch Path of Command (iter21 drop). There is no to-hit aura in the 10e codex text. The LeaderAbility entry is retained with no offensive flags so lookup_ability resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md rule 13 and host_keys gating (Necron Warriors, Immortals, Lychguard) continues to verify the led-unit attachment. UNMODELLED: per-character once-per-round Stratagem command point discount — no such hook exists in the simulator. BSData v10.6.0 Necrons.cat.gz, Overlord profile, typeName Abilities.

LeaderAbility.Chronometron.quoted_text: In your Shooting phase, after this model's unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 5" as if it were your Movement phase. If it does, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
LeaderAbility.Chronometron.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. wave 235 removed the prior fnp=5 fabricated proxy. The real Chronometron is a post-Shooting-phase 5-inch Normal move (a movement-phase-style trigger), not a feel no pain save. The simulator has no post-shooting-phase movement hook for led units; the proxy was direction-wrong (movement ability proxied as defensive feel no pain). The LeaderAbility entry is retained with no buff flags so lookup_ability resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md rule 13. UNMODELLED: post-Shooting Normal move up to 5 inches when not in Engagement Range — parking-lot until a post-shooting movement-trigger layer lands. BSData v10.6.0 Necrons.cat.gz, Chronomancer profile, typeName Abilities.

LeaderAbility.Harbinger of Destruction.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
LeaderAbility.Harbinger of Destruction.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. wave 235 removed the prior fnp=5 fabricated proxy. The real Harbinger of Destruction lowers the ranged Critical Hit threshold from 6 to 5+ on the led unit's ranged attacks. The faithful rebuild requires new machinery: the existing melee_crit_threshold variable in code/units.py lowers the crit threshold for melee only (see line ~3523); the ranged crit path (line ~3816) is hard-coded to unmodified_roll == 6 with no variable or leader-aura hook. Wiring ranged crit-on-5+ from a leader aura would require (a) a new ranged_crit_threshold_aura field on LeaderAbility and (b) a new att_buffs read in the ranged crit branch of code/units.py — new machinery outside this wave's scope. The LeaderAbility entry is retained with no buff flags so lookup_ability resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md rule 13. UNMODELLED: ranged crit-hit threshold lowered to 5+ on the led unit — parking-lot until a ranged-crit-threshold leader-aura field is added. BSData v10.6.0 Necrons.cat.gz, Plasmancer profile, typeName Abilities.

LeaderAbility.Canoptek Cloak.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
LeaderAbility.Canoptek Cloak.trigger: defender's unit is led by a Technomancer in aura range
LeaderAbility.Canoptek Cloak.effect: FNP 5+ in aura range (faithful match — our LeaderAbility.name 'Canoptek Cloak' is a flavour label for the codex ability 'Rites of Reanimation')

LeaderAbility.Might is Right.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Might is Right.trigger: attacker's unit is led by an Ork Warboss or Warboss In Mega Armour (host_keys: orks_boyz, orks_nobz, orks_meganobz) AND the attack is a melee attack (mode == "melee"); ranged attacks by the same unit are unaffected. ORKS-DIAG-3: fixed from prior `plus_one_to_hit=True` (all attack modes) to `plus_one_to_hit_melee_only=True` (melee only), matching the codex text. Also added orks_meganobz to host_keys so the Warboss In Mega Armour correctly leads Meganobz.
LeaderAbility.Might is Right.effect: +1 to the Hit roll on melee attacks only

LeaderAbility.Synaptic Imperative.quoted_text: While a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] and [LETHAL HITS] abilities.
LeaderAbility.Synaptic Imperative.trigger: attacker's unit is a Tyranids friendly within 6" of a Hive Tyrant (Hive Tyrant is a Monster, not a formal attached leader)
LeaderAbility.Synaptic Imperative.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. TYRANIDS-DIAG-7 (2026-05-26): dropped the prior `reroll_wound_ones=True` proxy. The real Onslaught grants [ASSAULT] and [LETHAL HITS] to RANGED weapons only. The previous proxy fired `reroll_wound_ones` in both ranged and melee attack resolutions (the `effective_buffs` merge has no mode gate), incorrectly buffing every Tyranid melee attack in range. Additionally, `reroll_wound_ones` is the wrong mechanic — the real effect is [LETHAL HITS] on ranged (natural 6 to hit auto-wounds) plus [ASSAULT] (shoot after Advancing). The `transient_lethal_hits` path exists in the simulator but the `LeaderAbility` schema has no ranged-only lethal-hits field; wiring it army-wide via the existing schema would re-introduce the ranged+melee over-buff in a different form. Ship NO-FLAG per CLAUDE.md §10 (no-flag over fabrication). Will return as `lethal_hits_ranged=True` once the LeaderAbility schema gains a ranged-only lethal-hits slot. Registry entry retained so `lookup_ability('Hive Tyrant')` resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md §13 and the broadcast-aura convention (empty host_keys) is preserved for when the flag is added.

LeaderAbility.Word of the Phoenix.rule_name: Word of the Phoenix (Psychic) + Herald of Ynnead
LeaderAbility.Word of the Phoenix.quoted_text: Word of the Phoenix (Psychic): While this model is leading a unit, in your Command phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, D3+1 destroyed Bodyguard models (excluding Support Weapon models) are returned to that unit with their full wounds remaining. Herald of Ynnead: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model. Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly Aeldari model makes an attack that targets that unit, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
LeaderAbility.Word of the Phoenix.trigger: Yvraine is alive and leading an Aeldari Bodyguard unit (Word of the Phoenix fires at end of each round via apply_round_end_revival; Herald is an always-on reroll-wound-1s proxy)
LeaderAbility.Word of the Phoenix.effect: (approximation) revive 1 destroyed friendly INFANTRY model per round end at full HP, preferring profiles whose live peers are in the 6" aura (encoded as revive_destroyed_per_round=1). Re-roll Wound rolls of 1 in aura. The codex's Word of the Phoenix returns D3+1 (median 3) on a 2+ (success rate 5/6) — effective ~2.5 models/round in the codex. iter15 modelled this as 2/round; iter17 dropped to 1/round because the simulator's apply_round_end_revival fires unconditionally each round whether or not a Bodyguard model actually died (the codex would no-op on a zero-casualty round). 1/round better matches an "average 1 model dies per round on the Yvraine-led unit * D3+1 median heal * 2+ success rate" expectation. The Herald of Ynnead Fight-phase target-marker is approximated as an always-on aura since the simulator's leader-aura layer doesn't expose per-target marker-buffs; this overshoots slightly versus the codex's target-restricted spec.

LeaderAbility.Ethereal Form.quoted_text: Ethereal Form: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit it regains up to D3 lost wounds. Inevitable Death: Once in each of your opponent's turns, if this model is on the battlefield when another friendly Aeldari unit is destroyed, just after removing the last model in that unit, you can remove this model from the battlefield and set it up as close as possible to where that destroyed model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
LeaderAbility.Ethereal Form.trigger: The Yncarne (the killer unit) destroys an enemy unit — fires at each of the four kill sites in simulator.py (shooting, melee, Tank Shock, Counter-Offensive) via maybe_apply_yncarne_heal(killer, killer_army, rng). The trigger is KILLER-scoped: only kills made by the Yncarne itself count, not any enemy dying anywhere on the battlefield.
LeaderAbility.Ethereal Form.effect: Roll 1D3; restore that many lost wounds to the Yncarne itself, capped at its starting wound total. Implemented via LeaderAbility.heal_d3_on_kill=True and maybe_apply_yncarne_heal in code/leaders.py. wave 241 replaced the unconditional heal_per_round=1 drip (an approximation) with this faithful on-kill hook. Inevitable Death (reactive teleport on Aeldari unit death) is NOT modelled — SwegHammer has no reactive-relocation hook in the death-detection code paths.

LeaderAbility.Runes of Fate.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, once per phase, you can change the result of one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit (excluding SUPPORT WEAPON models) to an unmodified 6.
LeaderAbility.Runes of Fate.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Farseer in aura range (NOT modelled — the simulator has no once-per-phase set-roll-to-6 leader hook)
LeaderAbility.Runes of Fate.effect: No buff. wave 236 fab audit: Branching Fates is a once-per-phase set-one-roll-to-6 ability — it is gated (once per phase), targets one specific roll, and sets it to 6. The previous reroll_wound_ones=True flag was an always-on wound-reroll aura with no codex support for that mechanic. BSData v10.6.0 (Aeldari - Aeldari Library.cat.gz, ability id 1db8-859e-c4c7-d8b2) confirms the verbatim text above. Proxy removed on the same standard as Autarch 'Path of Command' (iter21) and Avatar of Khaine 'Bloody-Handed' (iter21) — no offensive aura flag is better than a systematically over-buffing wrong-mechanic proxy. LeaderAbility.Path of Command.quoted_text: Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.
LeaderAbility.Path of Command.trigger: Autarch is alive and the army uses a Stratagem targeting its unit (NOT modelled — the simulator has no per-character Stratagem CP-discount hook)
LeaderAbility.Path of Command.effect: No buff. iter21 fab audit: Path of Command is IDENTICAL in pattern to Necron Overlord 'My Will Be Done' (which iter20 audited and dropped the +1-to-hit proxy from). Both rules are once-per-round Stratagem CP discounts — neither carries an offensive aura. The previous citation's '+1 to Hit in aura range' was an invented proxy with no codex support. Registry entry retained (with host_keys for is_actually_led gating purposes) but with no offensive flag. Will return as a CP-discount Warlord ability once per-character one-Stratagem-per-round discounts are added (parallel to the cp_discount_per_round / cp_refund_per_battle Warlord mechanics).

LeaderAbility.Avatar's Fury.quoted_text: While a friendly AELDARI unit is within 6" of this model, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.
LeaderAbility.Avatar's Fury.trigger: any friendly Aeldari unit is within 6" of the Avatar of Khaine (Monster, no formal leader attachment) — NOT modelled (movement-phase buff with no leader-modifier hook in charge / advance resolution)
LeaderAbility.Avatar's Fury.effect: No buff. iter21 fab audit: the previous reroll_hit_ones=True aura was a known wrong-buff-type proxy — the codex grants +1 to Advance and Charge rolls (a movement-phase buff), not a Hit-roll modifier. The previous citation explicitly admitted 'Known limitation: wrong buff TYPE — direction-correct but mechanically unrelated.' iter21 drops the proxy on the same standard iter20 applied to Typhus's wrong-direction FNP and Necron Overlord's invented +1-to-hit. Registry entry kept (Monster, no host_keys); will return as a charge / advance roll modifier once the charge resolver gains a leader-buff hook.

LeaderAbility.Failure Is Not an Option.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.
LeaderAbility.Failure Is Not an Option.trigger: defender's unit is led by an Ethereal in aura range
LeaderAbility.Failure Is Not an Option.effect: FNP 5+ in aura range (faithful match — the codex grants Feel No Pain 5+ to the led unit; the simulator implements this as fnp=5 on the LeaderAbility, which Unit.attack consumes via the target buffs' fnp field). Direction-correct defensive aura.

LeaderAbility.Coordinated Fire Plan.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a Move characteristic of 12" and ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.
LeaderAbility.Coordinated Fire Plan.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a T'au Commander in aura range (Coldstar variant cited as canonical example; sister Commander variants — Enforcer, Crisis — have differently-named auras)
LeaderAbility.Coordinated Fire Plan.effect: Faithful default (SWEG_TAU_CMD on): NO offensive buff. The real rule grants the led unit a Move characteristic of 12" and the [ASSAULT] ability on its ranged weapons; the simulator models neither Movement-characteristic bonuses nor a leader-granted [ASSAULT] keyword, so the ability is left offensively inert rather than fabricating a Hit-roll bonus the rule does not give. The prior implementation proxied it as plus_one_to_hit with no host_keys, which the LeaderAbility convention treats as ARMY-WIDE, fabricating an army-wide +1 to Hit that over-credited all T'au shooting; that proxy is removed. SWEG_TAU_CMD=0 reverts to the prior fabricated +1-to-hit for the A/B comparison.

LeaderAbility.Volley Fire.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit.
LeaderAbility.Volley Fire.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Cadre Fireblade in aura range
LeaderAbility.Volley Fire.effect: +1 to the Attacks characteristic in aura range, implemented via the leader-aura plus_one_attack field (additively merged with detachment plus_one_attack in Unit.attack's n_attacks computation). The codex limits this to ranged weapons; SwegHammer's leader buff layer does not yet distinguish melee from ranged attacks, so the implementation grants +1 attack to all weapons of in-aura units. Strictly stronger than the codex's ranged-only effect by the melee-attack share — known overshoot but direction-correct.

LeaderAbility.Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch.quoted_text: While a friendly Rubric Marines or Tzaangor Enlightened unit contains this model, each time a Psychic Attack made by a model in that unit targets an enemy unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch.trigger: attacker's unit is led by Ahriman in aura range (proximity-gated); the led unit makes a Psychic Attack (ranged weapon with the PSYCHIC keyword) in the Shooting phase
LeaderAbility.Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch.effect: (approximation) re-roll Hit rolls of 1 on the led unit's Shooting-phase attacks only. The real Master of the Rubricae grants a full hit re-roll on Psychic Attacks only; SwegHammer does not tag attacks as Psychic vs non-Psychic, so we approximate by (a) proxying the full-reroll with re-roll-1s (same conservative direction used for other TSON leaders), and (b) restricting the re-roll to the Shooting phase via the reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only LeaderAbility field, which units.py applies with a mode != 'melee' guard. TSON-AURA-V2 (iter60): narrowed from the prior reroll_hit_ones=True (all phases) to reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only=True (Shooting-phase only). The codex rule is Psychic-Attack-only, which in 10e means ranged weapons carrying the [PSYCHIC] keyword; melee attacks from Rubric Marines carry no PSYCHIC tag and must receive no re-roll. host_keys = (thousand_sons_rubric_marines, thousand_sons_tzaangor_enlightened) per BSData Chaos - Thousand Sons.cat.gz Ahriman Leader profile: 'This model can be attached to the following unit: Rubric Marines, Tzaangor Enlightened'. TSON-AUDIT-V1 (wave-52): corrected quoted_text — previous version erroneously said 'Scarab Occult Terminators' in the host list; BSData confirms it is Tzaangor Enlightened.

LeaderAbility.Arcane Shield.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
LeaderAbility.Arcane Shield.trigger: defender's unit is led by a Thousand Sons Exalted Sorcerer (or substring match on 'Exalted Sorcerer') in aura range (proximity-gated)
LeaderAbility.Arcane Shield.effect: Grant the led unit a 4+ invulnerable save in aura range, wired via the LeaderAbility.extra_invuln=4 layer in effective_buffs. Faithful match to the codex effect — the only approximation is the proximity gate substitution for the formal 10e Leader/Bodyguard attachment (SwegHammer has no attachment registry, so 'leading' is approximated as 'in aura range AND host_keys list the attacker's UNIT_CATALOG key'). host_keys = (thousand_sons_rubric_marines,) covers the codex-legal attachment for the Exalted Sorcerer datasheet. Note: the BSData Sorcerer datasheet also carries Arcane Shield, but the generic 'Sorcerer' substring matches CSM/EmperorChildren/Daemon Sorcerers too — we only wire Exalted Sorcerer (unique TSON name) and Ahriman (also unique) cleanly. Foot 'Sorcerer' continues to resolve to the generic CSM 'Prescience' entry (FNP 5 defensive proxy) — TSON's foot Sorcerer is therefore slightly undermodelled but the bigger Arcane Shield 4+ invuln win is captured on Ahriman + Exalted Sorcerer. iter21 — TSON-leaders fab audit fix.

LeaderAbility.Malefic Maelstrom.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
LeaderAbility.Malefic Maelstrom.trigger: attacker's unit is led by an Infernal Master in aura range
LeaderAbility.Malefic Maelstrom.effect: (approximation) re-roll Hit rolls of 1 on the led unit's Shooting-phase attacks only. The real Malefic Maelstrom grants [SUSTAINED HITS 1] — each unmodified Hit roll of 6 generates one additional automatic Hit — applying to all weapons including melee. SwegHammer's leader-aura layer does not expose a per-aura sustained-hits-all-phases flag (the LeaderAbility.sustained_hits_ranged / sustained_hits_melee schema exists but the codex rule grants both together; splitting into ranged+melee separately would require two fields), so we proxy with reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only — a conservative approximation restricting the buff to the Shooting phase where Rubric Marines deal the majority of their damage. TSON-AURA-V2 (iter60): narrowed from prior reroll_hit_ones=True (all phases, including melee) to reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only=True (Shooting-phase only). The melee-leak was inflating TSON win rates beyond the Warp Friends target. host_keys = (thousand_sons_rubric_marines,) per the codex legal attachment. iter21 — adds the Infernal Master to the leader registry; previously lookup_ability('Infernal Master') returned None and his led Rubric squad received zero aura.

LeaderAbility.Marked by Fate.quoted_text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit that is visible to this Psyker model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Marked by Fate.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Sorcerer in Terminator Armour in aura range; codex applies +1 to Hit only against the marked enemy unit during the Shooting phase
LeaderAbility.Marked by Fate.effect: (approximation) unit-wide re-roll hit rolls of 1 on the Sorcerer-in-Terminator-Armour's led squad (Scarab Occult Terminators per BSData host infoLink) during the Shooting phase only. APPROXIMATION: the codex Marked by Fate effect is target-indexed (one designated enemy unit per Shooting phase); SwegHammer has no per-target hit-modifier plumbing so the buff fires unit-wide on the led unit against any target. The phase restriction IS now enforced: TSON-AURA-V2 (iter60) narrowed from reroll_hit_ones=True (all phases, including melee) to reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only=True (Shooting-phase only). The codex text is explicit: 'Until the end of the [Shooting] phase' — melee attacks by Scarab Occult Terminators must receive no re-roll from Marked by Fate. TSON-KOS-MESMERISING wave-44: the prior proxy (plus_one_to_hit=True) was a 3-dimensional over-buff vs codex (added melee + multi-target + multi-phase uplift). Replaced with reroll_hit_ones at that wave; narrowed further to reroll_hit_ones_shooting_only at iter60. host_keys = (thousand_sons_scarab_occult_terminators,) per the BSData Leader infoLink — Scarab Occult Terminators is the codex-legal attachment. iter21 — adds the Sorcerer in Terminator Armour to the leader registry as a TSON-specific entry. Without this, the substring 'Sorcerer' would match the generic CSM Prescience entry (FNP 5 defensive proxy) which is direction-wrong for the TSON datasheet's offensive Marked by Fate.

LeaderAbility.Magnus the Red.rule_name: Magnus the Red (EPIC HERO MONSTER PSYKER — placeholder registry entry, no leader-aura)
LeaderAbility.Magnus the Red.quoted_text: Magnus the Red is a Monster (not a Character) and does not have the Leader ability on his datasheet. His relevant abilities are: Unearthly Power / Impossible Form (Psychic) — 'Each time an attack is made against this Psyker (excluding Psychic Attacks), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.' Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psychic) — 'This model can attempt up to 2 Rituals per turn instead of one, and each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 2 to the Psychic test result.'
LeaderAbility.Magnus the Red.trigger: Magnus the Red is alive on the battlefield (his self-conferred rules; he does not formally lead any unit and does not confer a buff to nearby Thousand Sons units per the Wahapedia datasheet)
LeaderAbility.Magnus the Red.effect: NO LEADER-AURA EFFECT. Magnus's self-conferred rules are wired elsewhere — Impossible Form in code/simulator.py (transient_minus_one_damage_taken set at round start, cited at simulator.magnus_unearthly_power_impossible_form in data/rule_citations.d/thousand_sons.json) and Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers in code/simulator.py (Magnus attempts 2 Rituals/turn with +2 to Psychic test, cited at simulator.magnus_lord_of_the_planet). This LeaderAbility entry exists ONLY so lookup_ability("Magnus the Red") returns a non-None entity per CLAUDE.md §13 (no silent defaults — a missing leader lookup must not silently return None and let callers assume 'no buff'). The LeaderAbility has aura_range=0.0, host_keys=(), and no buff flags. Same pattern as Avatar of Khaine (LeaderAbility.Avatar's Fury above) which also has no formal leader attachment. iter24 wiring — closes the iter21 gap where Magnus was claimed wired but missing from _REGISTRY.

LeaderAbility.Prescience.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Prescience.trigger: defender's unit is led by a Chaos Sorcerer in aura range
LeaderAbility.Prescience.effect: FNP 5+ in aura range (defensive proxy; the real Prescience subtracts 1 from Hit rolls against the led unit — a DEFENSIVE -1-to-hit aura. Direction-correct (defensive). Our generic 'Sorcerer' key is a substring match — multiple Sorcerer datasheets exist; foot Sorcerer cited as canonical.)

LeaderAbility.Profane Litanies.quoted_text: While this unit is leading a unit and contains a DARK APOSTLE model, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.
LeaderAbility.Profane Litanies.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Dark Apostle in aura range
LeaderAbility.Profane Litanies.effect: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 in aura range (approximation; the real Dark Zealotry is +1 to the Wound roll on melee attacks. The simulator's reroll-1s-to-hit is a weaker offensive proxy; flagged for swap to plus_one_to_wound on melee once the registry distinguishes melee from ranged)

LeaderAbility.Lord of Hosts.quoted_text: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
LeaderAbility.Lord of Hosts.trigger: Chaos Lord is alive and a friendly Chaos Space Marines unit is targeted with a Stratagem (NOT modelled — the simulator has no per-character Stratagem command-point-discount hook)
LeaderAbility.Lord of Hosts.effect: No buff. wave 236 fab audit: Lord of Chaos is a once-per-battle-round Stratagem command-point-discount ability — identical in pattern to Autarch 'Path of Command' (iter21 drop) and Shield-Captain 'Master of the Stances' (CUSTODES-AUDIT drop). Neither carries an offensive aura. BSData v10.6.0 (Chaos - Chaos Space Marines.cat.gz, ability id 73e9-284e-fd62-4056) confirms the verbatim text above. Host routing corrected from the dormant chaos_space_marines_traitor_guardsmen_squad to chaos_space_marines_legionaries + chaos_space_marines_chosen per BSData Leader text. The flag was near-dormant (fired on absent units), so metric impact is near-neutral — this is a fidelity correction. Registry entry retained; will return as a command-point-discount Warlord ability once per-character Stratagem discounts are added.

LeaderAbility.Master of the Stances.rule_name: Master of the Stances / Strategic Mastery
LeaderAbility.Master of the Stances.quoted_text: Master of the Stances: Once per battle, when this model's unit is selected to fight, it can use this ability. If it does, until that fight is resolved, both Ka'tah Stances are active for that unit, instead of only one. Strategic Mastery: Once per battle round, you can select one model from your army with this ability. That model's unit can be targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP. Leader: This model can be attached to the following units: Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens.
LeaderAbility.Master of the Stances.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Shield-Captain in aura range (BSData v10.6.0 Leader text: 'Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens')
LeaderAbility.Master of the Stances.effect: NO IMPLEMENTATION. CUSTODES-AUDIT (claude/sim-calibration-6): removed the prior `reroll_hit_ones=True` fabricated proxy. The real Shield-Captain has no offensive hit-reroll aura — 'Master of the Stances' is a once-per-battle fight-phase stance-flexibility trigger (both Ka'tah stances active for one fight resolution) and 'Strategic Mastery' is a once-per-battle-round Stratagem CP discount, matching the same CP-discount pattern as Space Marine Captain 'Rites of Battle' (iter21 drop) and Autarch 'Path of Command' (iter21 drop). Neither ability translates to a per-attack aura in the simulator. The LeaderAbility entry is retained with no offensive flag so lookup_ability resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md §13 and host_keys gating (Custodian Guard + Wardens) continues to verify 'led by a CHARACTER'. Previously labelled 'Stoic Vigil' — not a real codex ability name; renamed to 'Master of the Stances' per the BSData verbatim ability name.

LeaderAbility.Auric Sage.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's Ballistic Skill or Weapon Skill characteristics and/or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Auric Sage.trigger: attacker's unit is led by Trajann Valoris in aura range (BSData Leader text: 'This model can be attached to the following units: Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens')
LeaderAbility.Auric Sage.effect: Captain-General is a modifier-CANCELLATION ability: it negates penalties to Ballistic Skill / Weapon Skill / Hit roll (typically -1-to-hit auras, Heavy without staying still, battle-shock). SwegHammer does not model hit-modifier penalties on the attack side, so the correct net effect of this rule in the current sim is approximately zero offensive contribution. SC5-3 (claude/sim-calibration-5) dropped the prior `plus_one_to_hit=True` fabrication that was self-flagged in this citation as an 'upper-bound flavour proxy' — it stacked on top of BS2+ Custodes (already 5/6 to hit) and contributed to the +31pt Custodes overshoot vs the May 2026 Warp Friends meta. The LeaderAbility entry is retained with no offensive aura field so lookup_ability resolves cleanly per CLAUDE.md §13, and so host-key gates (Resolute Will on Wardens) continue to verify 'led by a CHARACTER'. host_keys: Guard + Wardens, per the BSData Leader text.

LeaderAbility.Swift Onslaught.quoted_text: Martial Inspiration: Once per battle, in your Charge phase, this model's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced. Swift Onslaught: While this model is leading a unit, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit. Leader: This model can be attached to the following units: Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens.
LeaderAbility.Swift Onslaught.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Blade Champion in aura range (BSData Leader text: 'Custodian Guard, Custodian Wardens'); the offensive aura fields are unset because neither codex ability is currently expressible through the LeaderAbility schema
LeaderAbility.Swift Onslaught.effect: no aura modifier — entry exists structurally so lookup_ability resolves cleanly (per CLAUDE.md §13 fail-loud) and so host_keys-gated buffs (e.g. Resolute Will on a Blade-Champion-led Wardens squad) can verify 'the led unit has a CHARACTER attached'. The real codex abilities are once-per-battle advance + charge (Martial Inspiration) and re-roll Charge rolls (Swift Onslaught) — neither expressible in the current aura schema. Same iter21 fab-removal pattern as Captain / Autarch / Avatar of Khaine: registry entry without offensive flags.

LeaderAbility.Master of the Machine.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If that unit has the ELECTRO-PRIESTS keyword, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.
LeaderAbility.Master of the Machine.trigger: target unit is led by a Tech-Priest Dominus; the unit receives damage (host_keys-gated to the single attached unit, Kataphron Breachers)
LeaderAbility.Master of the Machine.effect: fnp=5 on the led unit (Feel No Pain 5+). ADMECH-DIAG-3 (2026-05-26): removed prior fabricated reroll_hit_ones=True and heal_per_round=1. Replaced with fnp=5. The ELECTRO-PRIESTS Feel No Pain 4+ branch is not implemented (LeaderAbility has no keyword-conditional fnp field); fnp=5 is the floor. ADMECH-DIAG-4 (2026-05-26): APPROXIMATION — Kataphron Breachers and Kataphron Destroyers removed from host_keys. The full BSData list is {Corpuscarii, Fulgurite, Kataphron Breachers, Kataphron Destroyers, Rangers, Vanguard}. The proximity-broadcast model does not enforce the 10e one-attachment-per-unit rule; when both Belisarius Cawl and the Dominus are simultaneously within aura_range, the 6-unit host list caused Feel No Pain 5+ to broadcast to Rangers, Vanguard, Kataphron Breachers, and Kataphron Destroyers concurrently. Kataphron units have no native Feel No Pain (base fnp=7) and the simultaneous grant to them inflated AdMech effective durability well beyond the tournament baseline (the Kataphron Breachers are 3-wound Toughness-5 models — Feel No Pain 5+ significantly increases their survivability). Electro-Priests retain their entries because both have native Feel No Pain 5+ from their own BSData infoLinks; the min() merge means the Dominus aura is a no-op for them and no over-application occurs. ADMECH-DIAG-6 (2026-05-26): APPROXIMATION — Skitarii Rangers and Skitarii Vanguard also removed from host_keys. The archetype list carries 2x Rangers and 2x Vanguard alongside one Dominus. The proximity-broadcast model fires Feel No Pain 5+ on all four units simultaneously when only one should receive it under the real 10e one-attachment-per-unit rule. Four concurrent Feel No Pain 5+ grants on 1-wound Toughness-3 Battleline squads (approximately 33% damage reduction each) inflated AdMech effective durability well beyond the tournament baseline. The prior neuter left only Electro-Priests (already native Feel No Pain 5+), making the aura a no-op. WAVE-147 (2026-06-03): re-pointed host_keys to a SINGLE-occurrence host — Kataphron Breachers appear exactly 1x in the Skitarii Hunter Cohort archetype, so the proximity broadcast reaches exactly one unit, faithfully modelling the real one-attachment FNP 5+ without over-applying (this is the single-unit re-add the ADMECH-DIAG-6 note anticipated once one-attachment could be approximated). Kataphron Breachers have no native Feel No Pain, so the grant is now live on one durable unit rather than a no-op.

LeaderAbility.Galvanic Field.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [Lethal Hits] ability.
LeaderAbility.Galvanic Field.trigger: ranged attacker unit is led by / within aura of a Tech-Priest Manipulus (host_keys-gated to the single attached unit, Kataphron Destroyers)
LeaderAbility.Galvanic Field.effect: the led unit's ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] (critical hit auto-wounds). Implemented as lethal_hits_ranged=True on the Manipulus LeaderAbility; consumed in code/units.py attack() on the ranged side (mode != "melee" guard), mirroring the ranged p.lethal_hits profile field. host_keys is the single-occurrence Kataphron Destroyers (1x in the Skitarii Hunter Cohort archetype) so the proximity broadcast reaches exactly one unit, modelling the real one-attachment without over-applying.

LeaderAbility.Plague-Ridden Champion.rule_name: Vector of Disease / Lord of the Death Guard (Warlord trait)
LeaderAbility.Plague-Ridden Champion.quoted_text: Vector of Disease: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [LANCE] abilities. Lord of the Death Guard (Warlord trait, codex): the first Stratagem your army uses each battle round costs 0CP.
LeaderAbility.Plague-Ridden Champion.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Lord of Contagion in aura range (Vector of Disease aura); OR this army's Warlord is a Lord of Contagion (Lord of the Death Guard)
LeaderAbility.Plague-Ridden Champion.effect: +1 to Wound in aura range (proxy for Vector of Disease's SUSTAINED HITS 1 + LANCE on melee — neither keyword modelled). When fielded as Warlord, additionally: the first Stratagem this army fires each round has its CP cost refunded immediately, via `Army.first_stratagem_free_this_round` re-armed at the top of every Command phase. The Warlord-trait gate fires only when `warlord_ability(army)` resolves to this LeaderAbility — a non-Warlord LoC does not enable the discount.

LeaderAbility.The Destroyer Hive.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a melee attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.The Destroyer Hive.trigger: defender's unit is led by Typhus in aura range
LeaderAbility.The Destroyer Hive.effect: FNP 5+ in aura range (defensive proxy; the real Destroyer Hive subtracts 1 from Hit rolls on melee attacks against the led unit. SwegHammer's leader-aura layer does not yet expose a melee-only -1-to-hit modifier on the target side, so we proxy the defensive bundle as FNP 5+ — strictly weaker on melee-heavy match-ups but direction-correct. LeaderAbility.First to the Fray.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

LeaderAbility.First to the Fray.effect: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 in aura range (approximation; the real Hammerhand grants LETHAL HITS to the led unit's melee weapons. The simulator does not model LETHAL HITS, so reroll-1s-to-hit is a flavour proxy for the Grey Knights' precision-strike role)

LeaderAbility.Tactical Acumen.quoted_text: Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when its unit is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.
LeaderAbility.Tactical Acumen.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Grand Master in aura range
LeaderAbility.Tactical Acumen.effect: +1 to Wound in aura range (approximation; the real Warrior Strategist is a once-per-round Stratagem CP discount, which the simulator does not model. The +1-to-wound aura is a flavour proxy for the Grand Master as senior battle commander)

LeaderAbility.Overlord of Commorragh.quoted_text: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when you select this model's unit to shoot or fight, you can spend 1 Pain token to Empower that unit. While that unit is Empowered, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

LeaderAbility.Might From Beyond.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
LeaderAbility.Might From Beyond.trigger: Patriarch is leading a friendly Purestrain Genestealers unit; the led unit makes a melee attack
LeaderAbility.Might From Beyond.effect: led Purestrain Genestealers' melee attacks gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] — critical wounds (unmodified Wound roll of 6) deal mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic and the attack sequence ends. Modelled as grants_devastating_wounds_melee=True; the melee-only gate is enforced in the attack-resolution loop in code/units.py (fires only when mode == 'melee'). Identical mechanism to Skulltaker's Lord of Decapitations. BSData v10.6.0 Genestealer Cults.cat.gz confirmed; no Wahapedia fetch needed.

LeaderAbility.Cult Demagogue.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can add 1 to the Hit roll.
LeaderAbility.Cult Demagogue.trigger: attacker's unit is led by a Genestealer Cults Primus in aura range
LeaderAbility.Cult Demagogue.effect: +1 to the Hit roll on every attack made by the led unit. Corrected from the prior reroll_hit_ones proxy (named 'Meticulous Uprising', a fabrication). The codex ability is named 'Cult Demagogue' and grants a full unconditional +1-to-Hit — strictly stronger than re-rolling 1s; plus_one_to_hit=True is the accurate implementation. Hosts expanded from the prior two variants to all four codex-legal bodyguard units: Acolyte Hybrids (both loadout variants), Hybrid Metamorphs, and Neophyte Hybrids. BSData v10.6.0 Genestealer Cults.cat.gz confirmed.

LeaderAbility.Warrior-Forged Leadership.quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

LeaderAbility.Warrior-Forged Leadership.effect: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 in aura range (approximation; the real Kindred Hero grants LETHAL HITS to all weapons in the led unit — Critical Hits auto-wound. The simulator does not model the LETHAL HITS keyword. VOTANN-JUDGEMENT-TOKENS-V1 (2026-05-28) downgraded the earlier +1-to-hit proxy to re-roll Hit 1s: on a BS4+ shooter LETHAL HITS yields ~+17% wounds, the +1-to-hit proxy yielded ~+33% wounds — a roughly 2× over-buff. simulator.abaddon_paragon_of_hatred.quoted_text: While a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit (excluding DAMNED units) is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.
simulator.abaddon_paragon_of_hatred.trigger: Abaddon the Despoiler selects the Paragon of Hatred Warmaster ability in the Command phase (SwegHammer: always assumed in competitive games); a friendly HERETIC ASTARTES unit within 6" makes an attack
simulator.abaddon_paragon_of_hatred.effect: re-roll Hit rolls (reroll_hit_ones=True) for friendly HERETIC ASTARTES units within 6" of Abaddon. Modelled as an army-wide broadcast aura (host_keys=() so the range check fires against all friendly units, not just the attached bodyguard). APPROXIMATION: the codex grants a full re-roll of ANY hit roll; SwegHammer maps this to reroll_hit_ones (re-roll natural 1s), which is the weaker proxy direction. The real Warmaster mechanic requires selecting the ability at the start of the Command phase — SwegHammer always picks Paragon of Hatred as the dominant offensive choice. Gated SWEG_CSM_ABILITIES (default-off). Verbatim text cross-checked against BSData v10.6.0 Chaos Space Marines.cat.gz, ability id 8b8a-6967-9f60-3de0, typeName Warmaster.

LeaderAbility.Daemonkin (Psychic).quoted_text: While this model is leading a unit, add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for that unit.
LeaderAbility.Daemonkin (Psychic).trigger: Master of Possession is leading a unit (host_keys: Chosen, Legionaries, Possessed); the led unit Advances or Charges
LeaderAbility.Daemonkin (Psychic).effect: NO OFFENSIVE AURA IMPLEMENTED. The real Daemonkin (Psychic) ability is a Movement-phase roll modifier (+1 to Advance and Charge rolls). The simulator has no Advance/Charge roll leader-aura hook in LeaderAbility; this ability is parking-lot until a charge-roll modifier field is added. The second datasheet ability, Sacrificial Dagger (BSData id 9aca-bf2a-148d-b019: 'Once per phase, when this model is selected to shoot or fight, it can use this ability. If it does, this model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound and, until the end of the phase, each time this model makes a Psychic Attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll'), is a self-activation once-per-phase mortal-wound trade affecting only the Master of Possession's own Psychic Attacks — not a persistent led-unit aura — and is also unmodelled. Registry entry exists so lookup_ability("Master of Possession") returns non-None per CLAUDE.md rule 13 (fail loud). No buff flags set.

LeaderAbility.Master of Mechanisms.quoted_text: In your Command phase, select one friendly HERETIC ASTARTES VEHICLE model within 3" of this model. That VEHICLE model regains up to D3 lost wounds and, until the start of your next Command phase, each time that VEHICLE makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. Each model can only be selected for this ability once per Command phase.
LeaderAbility.Master of Mechanisms.trigger: Warpsmith is alive; a friendly Heretic Astartes Vehicle model is within 3" at the start of the Command phase
LeaderAbility.Master of Mechanisms.effect: NO OFFENSIVE AURA IMPLEMENTED. Master of Mechanisms is a Command-phase vehicle-repair + per-Vehicle Hit-roll buff. It targets a VEHICLE model, not the Warpsmith's own led unit (Chosen / Havocs / Legionaries). The simulator has no per-leader Command-phase vehicle-repair hook in the leader layer; parking-lot. The Warpsmith's self-defence ability (Lone Operative within 3" of a Heretic Astartes Vehicle, BSData id 9451-72d-3d9e-1287) also does not affect the led unit. Enrage Machine Spirits (BSData id bc89-81a3-34db-b283: 'At the end of your Movement phase, select one enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of this model. That unit must take a Battle-shock test') is an enemy debuff in the Movement phase — also unmodelled. Registry entry exists so lookup_ability("Warpsmith") returns non-None per CLAUDE.md rule 13. No buff flags set.

LeaderAbility.Faithful Flock.quoted_text: While this unit is leading a unit and contains a CULT DEMAGOGUE model, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
LeaderAbility.Faithful Flock.trigger: Dark Commune is leading a unit (host_keys: Accursed Cultists, Cultist Mob) and the Dark Commune's unit contains a Cult Demagogue model
LeaderAbility.Faithful Flock.effect: extra_invuln=5 (5+ invulnerable save) on the led unit. The CULT DEMAGOGUE model is always present while the Dark Commune unit is alive — the Cult Demagogue is a named constituent model of the Dark Commune unit per the BSData datasheet (unit type 'unit', not 'model', contains multiple model entries including the Cult Demagogue). Therefore the condition 'contains a CULT DEMAGOGUE model' is always satisfied and extra_invuln=5 is the correct unconditional grant. The second ability Dark Ritual (BSData id 800b-10bd-2823-8a38: 'Once per battle, in your Command phase, if this unit contains a CULT DEMAGOGUE model, it can use this ability. If it does, until the end of the turn, this unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced and each time a model in this unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll') is a once-per-battle self-activation on the Dark Commune's own attacks — not a persistent led-unit aura — and is unmodelled. Parking-lot until a once-per-battle Command-phase trigger hook lands.
